info.title: Repeat a known count
info.text:
Use a count-controlled loop for a known count.

Be clear whether the last value is included.

OCR for loops include their stated end value.

Challenge: How many times does this loop print?

Three times, because 1, 2 and 3 are included.

info.title: Repeat until a condition
info.text:
A while loop checks before its body.

It can execute zero times.

The condition must eventually become false.

Challenge: When does the loop stop?

When count becomes 3, count < 3 is false.

info.title: Accumulate a total
info.text:
Set a starting total before the loop.

Add each new value to the running total.

Do not reset the total during each iteration.

Challenge: What goes wrong if total = 0 is inside the loop?

Earlier values are discarded at each iteration, so the running total is lost.

info.title: Guarantee progress
info.text:
A loop needs a way to reach its stopping case.

Update the control variable correctly.

Trace the update and condition together.

Challenge: What happens if the update is removed?

x stays 0, so x < 3 remains true and the loop does not terminate.

info.title: Selection inside a loop
info.text:
A loop can repeat a decision.

The decision runs for each item.

Only matching items affect the count.

Challenge: How many of 2, 7, 8 and 3 are at least 7?

Two values: 7 and 8.

info.title: Nested loops
info.text:
An inner loop runs for each outer iteration.

Count repetitions at both levels.

Multiply fixed counts when both fully execute.

Challenge: How many prints for outer 4 and inner 3?

Twelve prints: the three inner iterations run for each of four outer iterations.
